establishedBeforeThisCycle.claim: DESI DR2 released flat-w0-wa posterior chains for BAO combined with Pantheon+, Union3, and the original DES-SN5YR likelihood under a common default CMB combination, plus alternatives using Plik and HiLLiPOP.
The three supernova compilations give materially different strengths and locations for the DESI DR2 dynamical-dark-energy preference.

The DES-Dovekie reanalysis supersedes the original DES-SN5YR release in its official repository and reports w0=-0.803+-0.054 and wa=-0.72+-0.21 with the evolving-dark-energy rejection reduced from 4.2 to 3.2 sigma and weak Bayesian preference.
A 2026 Bayesian reanalysis reports that evidence strength depends strongly on whether the original DES-SN5YR or corrected Dovekie calibration is used.
SH0ES reports H0=73.2+-0.9 km/s/Mpc for its full HST distance-ladder summary in the 2024 HST-JWST comparison.

boundedContributionOfThisCycle: Froze seventeen exact posterior files before analysis: sixteen DESI chain files with official SHA-256 values and one Dovekie chain pinned to a Git commit and blob.
Applied one retained-chain rule, one sampling gate, and one family/calibration influence metric to all four controlled DESI combinations.
Converted each joint-chain H0-rdrag product into a locally required rdrag distribution rather than multiplying published Gaussian marginals.
Separated a controlled CamSpec-versus-Plik substitution from the non-controlled cross-release Dovekie state check.
Recomputed all retained posterior moments in dependency-free Node and independently derived the local-ruler bridge by analytic reciprocal-normal moments.
notClaimed: No claim that the posterior summaries or influence metrics are scientifically novel before specialist review.
No claim that the descriptive original-DESY5 versus Dovekie shift is caused solely by calibration; their CMB combinations and processing also differ.
No claim that a short sound horizon is physically viable; the sampled chains assume standard pre-recombination physics and retain rdrag near 147 Mpc.
No claim that a 3-sigma posterior gap is a likelihood-ratio discovery significance.
No claim that the local distance ladder has passed the declared leave-one-anchor audit; this cycle freezes that contract but does not rerun its raw photometry.
